value.rationale: A classical symmetric 14-vertex solid has an explicit three-parameter random-section type law that varies markedly with anisotropy, yet its small-angle section-change susceptibility is exactly 4/pi for every positive orthogonal stretch. The invariant normal-sphere interface length 8pi is structural rather than a conventional kinematic identity alone. This provides a natural and potentially reusable distinction between typical stereological frequency and its local orientation sensitivity.
